newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Richter soars after CSFB "hold" rating.
newsitem.headline: Richter soars after CSFB "hold" rating.

text.p: Shares in Hungary's Richter Gedeon Rt advanced to record territory on Wednesday following a hold recommendation by CS First Boston.
Richter opened at 11,880 forints, a little weaker than yesterday's closing price of 11,895 and went up to a new high of 12,500 forints. At 1208 GMT it traded at the record level.

Traders said the pharmaceuticals share rose on the back of good annual results released on Tuesday. Richter initally dipped after the news on Tuesday but traders said that the fall stemmed from the market sentiment and not from the results.
The BUX index began a recovery on Wednesday after a two percent fall the previous day, traders said.
"We are maintaining our "hold" recommendation on Richter following the publication of its full-year results," CSFB's Budapest based analyst Spencer Jakab said.
